IMP-001 [P3] [OTHER] [reproduced] [note]
expected: the portable release tree contains only declared runtime artifacts; a test binary at the repository root, if present, has the same bytes as the canonical build/release test binary so a verifier run there proves the shipped code.
actual: bzconv_tests.exe at the repository root (mtime 2026-11-23 21:13, size 5002904) has SHA256 829947aeca642d6b65e1687291850d169dda702a77ac9452a304a33eccf77eeb, while build/bzconv_tests.exe and release/bzconv_tests.exe both have ec4148c225cdfd23fe777e83b67b39d4ed002baaa27990297a229fca77750b66 and are the only paths recorded in RELEASE_EVIDENCE.json artifact_sha256. The root copy is ignored by .gitignore (*.exe) and untracked by any T-14 release_scope path, yet it passes 35/35 tests, so a verifier/suite invocation that resolves the root name would report green against non-release bytes (an ACCIDENTAL_SUCCESS condition).
evidence: sha256sum bzconv_tests.exe build/bzconv_tests.exe release/bzconv_tests.exe; ./bzconv_tests.exe -> 35/35 passed exit0; grep RELEASE_EVIDENCE.json lists only build/ and release/ test binaries; .gitignore *.exe; stat mtime 2026-11-23 21:13.
